name: Traveling Light
effect: Roll +1 die during Travel Rolls. You are unencumbered, which may make it easier to climb, swim, or other activities where a lighter load would help. When this would help, gain +1 die on an appropriate Skill Challenge or Interaction.

name: Discover
effect: Roll 2d6 and consult the Discovery Chart for this region.

name: Scout
effect: When the next _Encounter_ is drawn you have advanced warning and can react accordingly.

name: Focused Travel
effect: Reroll one [ ], keeping the new result.

name: Aid
effect: Choose any ally and give them one of your [+]/[-].

name: Hunt
effect: Roll 2d6 then consult the Hunting Chart for this Region to determine the reward. Characters may only select this option if they have an Attack that is at least Range 2 or other appropriate hunting gear.

name: Forage
effect: Roll 2d6 then consult the Forage Chart for this Region to determine the reward.

name: Navigate
effect: Reroll your _Navigation Roll_ for the day, then take the better result.

name: Forced March
effect: All party members must take this action to gain the benefit. Mark +1 _Progress_.

name: Hide Tracks
effect: You cover the trail behind you, effectively masking the presence of one party member.

name: Find Camp
effect: If you _Make Camp_ now you may remove a single negative modifier from the camp or add _Hidden_, _Defensible_, or _Comfortable_.

name: Track
effect: Roll a d6, then compare it to the current Tracking DC. If you succeed, you continue to follow the trail.

name: Rest
effect: You and your Spirit gain an additional die on your Rest Roll.

name: Connect
effect: Choose another character to spend time talking and bonding with. You must both take this _Camp Action_. The two of you roleplay a quick scene. If you don't have a _Bond_, gain a _Bond_ and both roll a d6; on a 4+, clear a _Stress_. If you already have a _Bond_, instead both clear a _Stress_.

name: Patch
effect: You or another character may immediately mark one segment on a Wound Clock. A character may only benefit from this once per Camp.

name: Unencumbered
effect: Gain +1 _Speed_.

name: Traveling Heavy
effect: Add an additional _Affliction_ (_Fatigue_) Danger while traveling. You are heavily encumbered, which may make it harder to climb, swim, or other activities where a lighter load would help. When this would hurt, lose 1 die on an appropriate Skill Challenge or Interaction.

name: Basic Flamecraft
effect:
You have basic skill with all Flamecraft disciplines:
* **Flamesense**: You can sense the rough location of nearby fire, flammable objects, and detect obvious flamecraft.
* **Flamecraft**: You can control and quench small flames and create a small candle fire without fuel.
* **Furnacecraft**: You can slowly heat objects you are touching and the air around you.
* **Flickercraft**: When looking into a large flame you can get vague, hazy flickers of the future.
* **Fuelcraft**: You can modestly enhance your physical capabilities in brief flashes.
* **Wrathcraft**: You incite minor feelings of rage in others.

You are clumsy with this craft, and struggle to use it quickly or under pressure and does not typically provide die on Skill Challenges. Your _Spirit_ may take a _Stress_ to grant you enhanced effect with a single specialization for the rest of the scene.

name: Basic Windcraft
effect:
You have basic skill with all Windcraft disciplines:
* **Windsense**: You can sense how air nearby is moving and detect obvious windcraft.
* **Galecraft**: You can control the air, and can create weak bursts of wind, capable of moving small objects.
* **Stormcraft**: You can shield yourself from static shocks and create small sparks of electricity.
* **Breezecraft**: You can extend your senses through the wind, and can detect things carried by the wind from a greater distance.
* **Nimblecraft**: You can modestly enhance your speed and reaction time.
* **Terrorcraft**: You can incite minor feelings of fear in others.

You are clumsy with this craft, and struggle to use it quickly or under pressure and does not typically provide die on Skill Challenges. Your _Spirit_ may take a _Stress_ to grant you enhanced effect with a single specialization for the rest of the scene.

name: Basic Metalcraft
effect:
You have basic skill with all Metalcraft disciplines:
* **Metalsense**: You can sense the rough location of nearby metal and detect obvious metalcraft.
* **Lodecraft**: You may move and control a single nearby metal object that you could hold in one hand.
* **Anvilcraft**: You modestly change the properties of metal, such as making it stronger or weaker.
* **Silvercraft**: You can modestly enhance your mental faculties, allowing you to better recall memories and giving extra time to think.
* **Adamantcraft**: You can modestly enhance your endurance and pain tolerance.
* **Griefcraft**: You can incite minor feelings of grief in others.

You are clumsy with this craft, and struggle to use it quickly or under pressure and does not typically provide die on Skill Challenges. Your _Spirit_ may take a _Stress_ to grant you enhanced effect with a single specialization for the rest of the scene.

name: Basic Earthcraft
effect:
You have basic skill with all Earthcraft disciplines:
* **Earthsense**: You can sense the rough location of nearby earth and detect obvious earthcraft.
* **Stonecraft**: You may control a single nearby earthen object that you could hold in one hand.
* **Landcraft**: You can manipulate nearby earth and soil as if you had a small shovel.
* **Tremorcraft**: You can feel vibrations through the earth, allowing you to track the location of things near you.
* **Mightcraft**: You can modestly enhance your physical strength and vitality.
* **Heartcraft**: You can incite minor feelings of courage in others.

You are clumsy with this craft, and struggle to use it quickly or under pressure and does not typically provide die on Skill Challenges. Your _Spirit_ may take a _Stress_ to grant you enhanced effect with a single specialization for the rest of the scene.

name: Basic Watercraft
effect:
You have basic skill with all Watercraft disciplines:
* **Watersense**: You can sense the rough location of nearby water and detect obvious watercraft.
* **Tidecraft**: You may move and control approximately a pitcher's worth of nearby water.
* **Frostcraft**: You may move and control a single nearby ice object that you could hold in one hand and chill or freeze a glass of water.
* **Ripplecraft**: When looking at something submerged in water you can see vague visions of its recent past.
* **Bloodcraft**: You can manipulate a glass' worth of visible blood.
* **Serenecraft**: You can incite minor feelings of calm in others.

You are clumsy with this craft, and struggle to use it quickly or under pressure and does not typically provide die on Skill Challenges. Your _Spirit_ may take a _Stress_ to grant you enhanced effect with a single specialization for the rest of the scene.

name: Basic Woodcraft
effect:
You have basic skill with all Woodcraft disciplines:
* **Woodsense**: You can sense the rough location of nearby wood and detect obvious woodcraft.
* **Barkcraft**: You may move and control a single nearby wooden object that you could hold in one hand.
* **Bloomcraft**: You can help encourage growth in small plants, although the effort is fairly draining.
* **Auracraft**: You can glean a vague sense of the emotional state of nearby creatures.
* **Leechcraft**: While in contact with two living things you can transfer a small amount of energy from one to another.
* **Joycraft**: You can incite minor feelings of joy in others.

You are clumsy with this craft, and struggle to use it quickly or under pressure and does not typically provide die on Skill Challenges. Your _Spirit_ may take a _Stress_ to grant you enhanced effect with a single specialization for the rest of the scene.

name: Heavily Encumbered
effect: Gain -1 _Speed_.

name: Effort
effect:
Choose one:
* Gain 3 _Guard_.
* _Recover_ once.
* Gain 1 _Essence_. You may only choose this option twice per _Turn_.

enhances.name: Sprint
enhances.effect: Instead, gain 1 _Speed_.

enhances.name: Focused Craft
enhances.effect: Instead, gain 1 _Essence_.

name: Concentrate
effect: Gain _Concentrating_.

name: Manipulate
effect:
You attempt to manipulate a creature with body language, shouts, or basic insults. Choose one:
* <u>Confuse:</u> The Target must _Negate_ 4 or gain your choice of _Impaired_/_Exposed_.
* <u>Taunt:</u> The Target must _Negate_ 3 or gain _Taunted_. If you are _Engaged_, increase the DC by 1.
* <u>Inspect:</u> The Target must _Negate_ 4 or gain _Studied_.

enhances.name: Bon Mot
enhances.effect: Increase the Negate by 2 if you choose Confuse or Taunt. If you target a creature that speaks your language and craft an insult, instead increase it by 3.

name: Channel Earth
effect:
At _Respite_, gain _Essence_ based on the following:
* If the _Arena_ is sitting on top of solid earth (such as a wooden floor on the first floor of a house), gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Arena_ is _Earth_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you did not leave your _Arena_ last _Round_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you are underground or otherwise in a place of power for _Earth_, gain 2 _Essence_.

name: Channel Wind
effect:
At _Respite_, gain _Essence_ based on the following:
* If you are not _Restrained_ or underground gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you were in _Wind_ _Terrain_ last round, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you are in a different _Arena_ than you started last _Round_ in, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you are at high altitude or otherwise in a place of power for _Wind_, gain 2 _Essence_.

name: Channel Flame
effect:
At _Respite_, gain _Essence_ based on the following:
* If you are not _Soaked_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Arena_ is not _Water_ and you are not _Engaged_ with _Water_ _Terrain_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you dealt Damage last _Round_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Arena_ is a place of power for _Flame_, gain 2 _Essence_.

name: Channel Water
effect:
At _Respite_, gain _Essence_ based on the following:
* If you are not _Alight_ or in a _Desiccated_ _Arena_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If there is a _Watersource_ on the map, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you ended last _Round_ with at least half your _Guard_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Arena_ is _Water_ or you are in a place of power for _Water_, gain 2 _Essence_.

name: Channel Wood
effect:
At _Respite_, gain _Essence_ based on the following:
* If you are _Wearing_ at least 2 _Load_ of _Wood_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you are not _Wearing_ or _Engaged_ with 2 _Load_ or more of _Metal_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Stance_ is more than one _Phase_ from the one you chose in the previous _Round_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Arena_ is _Wood_ or you are in a place of power for _Wood_, gain 2 _Essence_.

name: Channel Metal
effect:
At _Respite_, gain _Essence_ based on the following:
* If you are _Wearing_ at least 2 _Load_ of _Metal_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If you are not _Wearing_ or _Engaged_ with 2 _Load_ or more of _Wood_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Stance_ is within one _Phase_ of the one you chose in the previous _Round_, gain 1 _Essence_.
* If your _Arena_ is _Metal_ or you are in a place of power for _Metal_, gain 2 _Essence_.

name: Disengage
effect: Do not create an [_Opening_] from spending the Speed. This ability cannot have its cost increased.
special: If you are in a _Mobility_ _Stance_, decrease the Cost by 1.

name: Counter
effect: Choose an Attack, adding [_Discount_ 1]. Automatically resolve that Attack as if it was a _Hit_ against the Attacker if they are in Range.

name: Delay
effect: Instead, act next _Phase_. You may not choose this if you already would be taking a _Turn_ next _Phase_ or if it is _Phase_ 6.

name: Perfect Parry
effect: _Negate_ at no cost. If you are in a _Defensive_ _Stance_, additionally gain +2 _Block_.

name: Perfect Dodge
effect: Immediately leave your current _Engagement_, paying all additional costs as normal. If this takes you out of Range of the triggering Attack, add _Glancing_.

name: Opportunity Attack
trigger: A creature you are _Engaged_ with creates an _Opening_.
effect: Use a Single-Target Attack [_Discount_ 2] against the triggering creature.

name: Lethal Strike
effect: Deal 4 _Bonus Damage_. If this Defeats the Target, gain 1 _Momentum_.

name: Flurry
effect: Repeat the Attack, adding [_Discount_ 2, _Follow-Up_ ] and gaining a +1 to the _Attack Roll_ if it was _Light_. If you triggered this with an Attack from a _Wielded_ _Weapon_ and use a second _Wielded_ _Weapon_ for the Attack, remove [_Follow-Up_].

name: Staggering Impact
effect:
Deal +1 Damage and, if the triggering Attack was _Heavy_, deal +2 _Stun_. Additionally, choose one:
* Add _Exposed_ [5].
* Add _Shatter_ [5].

name: Return
prereqs: In an _Arena_ with a _Source_ of your type
effect: X is the Range between you and your Companion. Stop being _Manifested_; at the start of the next _Round_, _Manifest_ in _Melee_ with your Companion or remain in an un-_Manifested_ state.

name: Gain Advantage
effect:
Choose one. If the triggering Effect was a _Miss_, instead choose both:
* Gain 1 _Momentum_.
* Gain 3 _Guard_.

name: Flank
trigger: A creature you are _Engaged_ with is Attacked by a creature other than you.
effect: Roll a d6. The attacker may replace one of their d6s with your die.

name: Spiritbound
effect:
Gain the following from your bond with your spirit:
* You can summon or dismiss your spirit with a thought and a gesture, either at your side or at a nearby object of the same element and at least as large as your spirit.
* You and your spirit experience increasing discomfort as you separate, with it becoming noticeable when on opposite sides of a town and rapidly increasing in intensity beyond that.
* Your spirit cannot speak, but you have an empathetic link and know its current mood, status, and approximate location as well as a hazy impression of the last hour of its memories. These effects go both ways.
* When not summoned, your spirit is dispersed into the local elements. Your spirit shares its awareness with you and you can feel its response to your actions through your empathetic bond.
* You have a natural aptitude when interacting with spirits of the element and animals of a similar category to your spirit.

name: Evade
effect: Make your _Defense Roll_ at _Advantage_.

enhances.name: Careful Dodge
enhances.effect: Add [_Safe_].

name: Interact
effect: Make a _Skill Check_ (if required) to resolve an interaction within Range. Common Interactions are typically a specific Terrain effect, spiritcraft, an objective on the battlefield, or when attempting to demoralize or persuade the enemy. Pay the cost with _Essence_ if using spiritcraft; otherwise, use _Momentum_.
special: You may use this with _Bend_; if you do, replace all Ranges with your _Bend_ _Range_.

enhances.name: High-Effort
enhances.effect: Gain +1 die on your Skill Challenge. You may repeat this _Enhancement_.

enhances.name: Distant Craft
enhances.effect: If using this with Spiritcraft, increase Range by 1, up to a maximum of 3. You may repeat this _Enhancement_.

name: Drop
effect: Place the Target anywhere within Range.

enhances.name: Bending
enhances.effect: Instead pay all _Costs_ with _Essence_. Use this as a _Bending Maneuver_.

enhances.name: Unstrap
enhances.effect: Instead, Target is a _Worn_ piece of _Equipment_.

enhances.name: Handoff
enhances.effect: Instead, a willing ally in _Melee_ _Range_ may immediately _Wield_ or _Wear_ the Target.

enhances.name: Toss
enhances.effect: Instead, Range is 1.

enhances.name: Catch!
enhances.effect: The Target must be _Small_-. A willing ally within _Range_ may immediately _Wield_ the Target if they have a _Free Hand_.

name: Equip
effect: Make the Target _Worn_ or _Wielded_, as applicable.
special: You may use this with _Bend_; if you do, pay all costs with _Essence_, replace all Ranges with your _Bend_ _Range_, and do not create an [_Opening_] with the Retrieve Enhancement.

enhances.name: Retrieve
enhances.effect: Instead, target an _Unattended_ piece of _Equipment_ in Range 0 or one _Worn_ or _Wielded_ by a willing Target in Melee Range.

enhances.name: Rummage
enhances.effect: Create an [_Opening_]. Instead, target a _Packed_ Item. Add [_Final_].

enhances.name: Bending
enhances.effect: Instead pay all _Costs_ with _Essence_. Use this as a _Bending Maneuver_.

name: Improvised Attack
effect: Use any _Wielded_ Item to make this Attack. If it is 0 _Load_, add [_Glancing_].

enhances.name: Balanced Attack
enhances.effect: Item used must be 2 _Load_. This is a _Balanced_ Attack and Range is _Melee_/0 (_Thrown_). Deal +_0/1/1/1_ _Stun_ and +_0/0/1/1_ Damage.

enhances.name: Heavy Attack
enhances.effect: Item used must be 3 _Load_. This is a _Heavy_ Attack and Range is Melee. Deal +_0/0/1/1_ _Stun_ and +_0/2/2/2_ Damage.

enhances.name: Chain
enhances.effect: Use a different Attack. Add [_Follow-Up_]. Additionally add [_Discount_ 1] if it is [_Unarmed_].

enhances.name: Bending
enhances.effect: Instead pay the _Cost_ with _Essence_ and remove [_Martial_, _Unarmed_]. Make this Attack as a _Bending Maneuver_.

name: Overpower
effect: Attack a Target within Range.

enhances.name: Grapple
enhances.effect: Inflict _Prone_/_Grabbed_ instead of _Push_/_Pull_, using the higher _Negate_ cost from the original effect.

enhances.name: Heavy Slam
enhances.effect: Deal +1 _Stun_ and increase the cost to _Negate_ by 2.

enhances.name: Bending
enhances.effect: Instead pay all _Costs_ with _Essence_ and remove [_Martial_, _Unarmed_]. Make this Attack as a _Bending Maneuver_.

name: Steal
effect: Attack a Target within Range. The Target reduces the Cost to _Negate_ by 2 if they are _Wielding_ the item.

enhances.name: Bending
enhances.effect: Instead pay the _Cost_ with _Essence_ and remove [_Martial_, _Unarmed_]. Make this Attack as a _Bending Maneuver_.

name: Deflect
effect: Gain 3 _Block_ against the triggering Attack.

name: Encourage
effect:
You call encouragement to the target. Choose one:
* They gain 3 _Guard_.
* They gain 1 _Momentum_.
* They may _Recover_.

enhances.name: Focused Encouragement
enhances.effect: Instead, choose two. You may choose the same effect.

name: Adrenaline Rush
trigger: None. You may use this _Reaction at any time, but only once per _Round_.
effect: Immediately gain 4 _Momentum_, then gain _Fatigue_.

name: Sinker
effect: You may not _Swim_, and immediately sink if you enter water. You do not specifically need to breathe, but are _Slowed_. Depending on where you are, you may be able to _Climb_ out of the water.

name: Frost Jack
effect: If a [_Cold_] effect successfully targets you while _Soaked_ add [_Piercing_] and _Shatter_, _Exposed_ [8].

name: Heat Conduction
effect:
You have three states: Heated, Normal, and Chilled.
* While Heated, you are one step _Weaker_ to _Cold_ and _Water_, and adds [_Fire_] to all _Martial_ _Attacks_.
* While Chilled, you are one step _Weaker_  to _Fire_, and adds [_Cold_] to all _Martial_ _Attacks_.
* Whenever you take _Fire_ Damage, move one step towards Heated. 
* Whenever you take _Cold_ Damage, move one step towards Chilled.
* Whenever you take _Water_ Damage, move one step towards Chilled but not beyond Normal.

name: Float
effect: So long as you are not _Restrained_ you may freely become or stop [_Flying_] at the start of the _Round_ and on your _Turn_.

name: Amorphous
effect: Your body is amorphous and you _Negate_ and escape _Grabbed_, _Entangled_, and _Restrained_ at half cost.

name: Extra Flammable
effect: Whenever you take [_Fire_] Damage, gain _Alight_.

name: Freezable
effect: Whenever you take [_Cold_] Damage, gain _Frozen_.

name: Regrowth
effect: Regain 1 _Stamina_ and 2 _Guard_ at _Respite_.

name: Swimmer
effect: You take none of the normal penalties from _Swimming_.
